notes.title: Pokémon adventure — Unified Dossier interface and battle opening
notes.text: Desktop windows use a 16:9 shell with a 16:9 battle field, side party roster and commands below. Original and Aperture share Poké Ball header branding and grouped settings. The composer companion now uses the same square-frame system with separated move and action rows. New saved battles open the full window automatically, including when Motion is off; ordinary replies and restored history do not force it open. Long names wrap inside detail pages and review confirmations stay in page flow.
